basePrompt:
Use case: compositing / precise-object-edit.
Asset type: NATIVE FORMAT ADAPTATION of the supplied finished campaign photograph, not a new concept.
Image 1 is the EXACT A1 V4 SOURCE PHOTO AND FAMILY IDENTITY reference. Recompose/outpaint this same scene into the requested NEW CANVAS ratio. Preserve the same father (beige cable-knit sweater), daughter (slate blue top), boy (beige top), original believable photographic faces, hairstyles, natural gestures and warm shared expression; do not swap identities or invent a new family. Retain the father leaning in, girl pointing next to the clue and thoughtful boy, with all three faces clearly visible.
Keep this exact blue-and-amber cozy room: navy sofa, orange cushion, knitted cream/navy throw, blue evening window on LEFT, woven amber lamp and oak bookcase/globe/plants on RIGHT. Maintain natural photographic skin/hair/materials, fine wood/fabric texture, no CGI gloss or airbrushed AI faces. Preserve the small orange ornate shield with teal tie peeking behind father's shoulder, the small blue cloud-headed suited character with teal tie and clipboard near the phone, and the tiny subtle green circuit-board character among books. These are exact approved soft painted pixel mascots, secondary accents with original identity, lighting, real contact and occlusion.
Keep the GAME interaction: exactly ONE blank ivory A4 sheet, ONE small physical smartphone close to the family, pencil, matte navy pen, muted teal marker diagonally crossing the lower-left paper corner with a real soft cast shadow. Hands and marker may overlap a small sheet edge, not the main paper area. Sheet must remain uniform BLANK ivory with photographed light/grain and real edge shadow, NO print/text/maze/QR. Phone screen must remain uniform near-black BLANK glass with subtle natural reflections, all FOUR inner screen corners unobstructed, realistic bezel and rounded glass. The exact real game screen and physically cropped real worksheet are composited later, both face the FAMILY across the table, not the viewer. Do not generate fake game pixels or any other game prop.
No advertising lettering, no brand logo, no text, no UI, no fake CTA, no watermark, no border, no empty padding panels. Continuous full-bleed real room and tabletop across the whole canvas. Typography will be added separately in the explicitly reserved areas. The new composition must feel intentionally photographed for its ratio, not merely crop/scale the old ad. Preserve family emotion, realism, paper+phone identity and original lighting style.
